notes.title: Demo now available for The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story!
notes.notes:
As of today, a demo is now available for The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story.
The demo allows you to play through the Prologue (the tutorial) and up to the point where you unravel the mysteries behind the first incident, set in 1922. 
Take this opportunity to enjoy the sleuthing experience of The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story! 

The Shijima family have suffered a chain of inexplicable deaths over the past century.
When Haruka Kagami, a mystery novelist, visits the Shiijmas, she finds herself taking on four different murder cases - occurring at different points in time.

The red camellia and the Fruit of Youth, which invite only death.
And the truth behind it all, waiting to be uncovered...
This is a new, unique mystery-adventure game about the question of eternal life. 

(The demo includes some specifications that work differently to the full game.)
(Save data from the demo cannot be carried over to the full game.)

notes.title: Криминальная Япония: Обзор The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story
notes.notes: Криминальные приключения обладают особым статусом в Японии, и речь не только о серии игр о Профессоре Лейтоне, Фениксе Райте или прошлогоднем фаворите чартов Murder by Numbers. Сериалы и аниме с детективным сюжетом тоже пользуются повышенным вниманием активной аудитории, поэтому нет ничего удивительного в том, что разработчики Metal Gear Rising и NieR: Automata Коитиро Ито и Ихара Дзюнъити решили попробовать свои силы в рамках успешного жанра при поддержке Square Enix.

notes.title: Contents of the Second Update
notes.notes:
●  Adjusted part of the “Rules for Reasoning”.
● Changed “Suspend” to “Save”.
● Improved the explanation in the tutorial about moving “Clues”.
● Improved the content of the notes in Chapter 5.

● Added the following features to Options:
　<Controls>
　・ Feature allowing cursor movement (both free and investigation) controls when using a gamepad to be set to either to left or right stick.
　・ Feature allowing adjustment of cursor movement speed (both free and investigation).
<Pattern Guide>
　・ Feature that toggles the Pattern Guide on “Clues” and “Mysteries”.

● Adjusted and improved the following areas in the Cognitive Reasoning Space.
　・ Enlarged the valid area, making it easier to fit “Clues”.
　・ Made it so the path can be moved whilst holding a “Clue”.
　・ Made improvements to allow you to skip through line-by-line when viewing “Hypotheses”.
　・ Made improvements to allow you to skip the whole summary conversation.
　・ Changed so that “Clues” can be connected from any point when connecting several “Clues” on the path.

● ! on the title screen. Fixed a bug that prevented the exclamation mark from disappearing.
● Fixed a bug that, under certain conditions, caused the video to stop before moving onto a question.
● Corrections of errors in the Korean text, and in the text and video for other languages.
● Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story 4K Video Pack is now available!
notes.notes:
The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story 4K Video Pack is available as of today.
Applying this DLC will allow you to upgrade the live-action video sections of The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story to ultra high definition.

Please follow the steps below to download the bonus separately.
1. Open your library and select "The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story".
2. Click "Manage DLC", displayed in the DLC section on the right-hand side.
3. Tick the box next to the DLC that you wish to download.
If the game itself is already installed, then following the steps above will install the DLC.
(In order to apply this DLC, you must possess the full game. Furthermore, there must be 36GB or more of available storage in addition to that required for the full game.)

In order to apply this DLC, you must possess the full game as well as 36GB or more of available storage. Please confirm your available storage space before applying the DLC.

notes.title: Progress Report Regarding Maximum Resolution
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for playing The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story.
This is a progress report regarding an issue concerning the live-action videos in the Steam version of The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story.

Desiring to resolve this issue as soon as possible, we considered replacing all of the video footage files. However, as we investigated this course of action, we discovered that correcting the video footage to the appropriate resolution would cause the amount of game data to increase, significantly exceeding the amount of storage listed under the recommended/minimum system requirements. 

Since we anticipate that there would be some players who would encounter issues with their system if we were to issue a compulsory installation that exceeds the volume of storage that we had previously advised, we would like to resolve this by providing free, additional DLC to be downloaded as desired, rather than by issuing a patch.

After applying the additional DLC that will be distributed for free, you will be able to enjoy the video footage at the resolution that was originally envisaged (3840x2160).

(After downloading the additional DLC, we expect that the game will exceed 50 GB of required storage.)

We anticipate the additional DLC will be available in late June. In order to prevent the occurrence of any future issues, we have reserved time for quality assurance checks. We offer our heartfelt apologies for making you wait so long. 

Once again, we apologise for the inconvenience and trouble caused to our customers, and ask for your patience for a short while longer.

notes.title: Maximum Resolution in the Steam Version of The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story
notes.notes:
6:30AM PST/ 2:30 PM BST on May 18th, 2022

Thank you very much for playing The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story. 

Although we have been giving the maximum resolution for the Steam version of The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story as 3840x2160, we have discovered that the live-action videos display at the unintended resolution of 1280x720.

This is an initial report to our customers, whilst we carry out investigations in order to swiftly resolve this issue. 

Once we have concluded our investigations and determined a course of action, we will make another announcement here.

We apologise for the inconvenience and trouble caused to our customers, and ask for your patience for a short while longer.

notes.title: How to redeem the Steam early purchase bonus
notes.notes:
The bonus DLC will not be downloaded automatically with the game. Please follow the steps below to download the bonus separately.
1. Open your library and select "The Centennial Case: A Shijima Story".
2. Click "Manage DLC", displayed in the DLC section on the right-hand side.
3. Tick the box next to the DLC that you wish to download.
If the game itself is already installed, then following the steps above will install the DLC.
(If the game itself has not yet been installed, the DLC will be downloaded and installed together with the game.)
